The defensive infrastructure classes in Dependencies/Foundation/

PatchShield, SaveShield, FailureRecord, FailedModsCatalog,
SubModuleConstructionGuard, CollectAssemblyTypesShim) adopt the design

under a clean-room rewrite. All code is original to TAOM.
